project.description: Axis is a quantitative yield protocol that issues USDx, a synthetic dollar backed by a market-neutral trading book. Returns come from closing price differences across venues, not from token emissions. sUSDx is the staked form that receives that yield. The operating company is Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd. in Singapore.
project.public_notice: According to GoPlus, this is a proxy contract. The contract owner can make code changes to the token contract including but not limited to disabling sells, changing fees, minting, transferring tokens etc. Exercise caution.
